docx.title: Lemon drizzle cake
paragraphs: Grandma's recipe. Serves 10. Bake at 180 °C (160 °C fan) for 45 to 50 minutes.
## Ingredients
- 225 g soft butter
- 225 g caster sugar
- 4 eggs
- 225 g self-raising flour
- Zest of 2 lemons
- For the drizzle: juice of 1½ lemons and 85 g sugar
## Method
Beat the butter and sugar until pale and fluffy, then add the eggs one at a time. Fold in the flour and lemon zest and spoon into a lined loaf tin.
While the cake is still warm, prick it all over with a skewer and pour over the lemon juice mixed with sugar. Leave it in the tin until completely cool.

docx.title: Q4 planning
paragraphs: Draft for the Lumen Studio check-in on 29 September.
## Goals
- Ship the three-step onboarding to all users by 15 November.
- Run a second usability round with 20 testers, including five screen-reader users.
- Replace the account-creation step with an optional sign-in later.
## Risks
The translation vendor needs final copy four weeks before release. If the copy slips past 10 October, Portuguese and Turkish ship in the following update.
## Budget
Twelve design days in October and eight in November, at the current day rate.
